description: This vertical section drawing, titled "Diagram 2.15 Wall type 2.1", depicts two parallel columns of rectangular masonry blocks. Each block is filled with a diagonal cross-hatch pattern, and they are stacked vertically, separated by thin horizontal lines. A horizontal line connects the inner vertical faces of the two columns at the center of the drawing, interrupted by a small vertical tick mark. The word "SECTION" is printed in capital letters in the bottom right corner.
